test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 25 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following is not the use of washing soda?

i. Manufacture of glass, soap and paper

ii. As a cleaning agent for domestic purposes

iii. For removing permanent hardness of water

iv. Baking cake
solution:
The correct answer is __**2 Only**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Washing soda (sodium carbonate, Na₂CO₃)** is commonly used in various domestic and industrial applications. It is important to understand its uses to identify which option is not applicable.
